summary: The stage breaks and Eren's Titan rises through it. A hammer of hardened flesh answers. The festival is a battlefield, and the nape is not where the person sits.

segments.ja: 拍手の底で、舞台の板が内側から割れます。割れる穴から、巨人の上半身が客席より高く出ます。出る体は、島から来たエレンの巨人です。巨人の手が、舞台の上のヴィリーを掴みます。掴む速度は、演説の最後の言葉より速いです。速い崩壊で、広場の祝福は悲鳴に変わります。変わる前列に、ガビとファルコがいます。いる子供たちの席は、もう観客の席ではありません。
segments.en: At the bottom of the applause, the boards of the stage split from the inside. From the splitting hole, a Titan's upper body comes out higher than the seats. The body that comes out is the Titan of Eren, who came from the island. The Titan's hand grabs Willy on the stage. The speed of the grab is faster than the last words of the speech. In the fast collapse, the square's blessing turns into screams. Gabi and Falco are in the front row that turns. The children's seats that are there are no longer an audience's seats.

senses: clapping one's hands in prayer (at a shrine)

segments.en: Willy had put his own death on the schedule. The death he had put there is carried out inside the Titan's hand. The diplomatic guests see the figure of it being carried out while they run. The fact they see is that the master of the speech vanished immediately after the declaration. Even after he vanished, his words remain in the seats. The words that remain have already made the world one army. Magath receives with guns the responsibility of having made it so.

segments.ja: ガビは、前列からウドとゾフィアの手を引いて逃げます。引く方向は、舞台から離れる路地です。離れる途中で、瓦礫が列を分けます。分ける衝撃を、ファルコは後ろから見ます。見る友人たちの姿が、煙で一度消えます。消える恐怖が、ガビの明るさを初めて割ります。割れる声で、彼女はまだ敵を撃とうとします。撃とうとする相手は、巨人そのものです。そのものに、候補の銃は届きません。
segments.en: Gabi runs from the front row, pulling Udo's and Zofia's hands. The direction she pulls is an alley away from the stage. On the way away, rubble splits the row. Falco sees the shock of the split from behind. The figures of the friends he sees disappear once in the smoke. The fear of disappearing splits Gabi's brightness for the first time. With the voice that splits, she still tries to shoot the enemy. The opponent she tries to shoot is the Titan itself. A candidate's gun does not reach that itself.

segments.ja: エレンの巨人が次の敵を探す前に、別の体が広場に立ちます。立つ体は、白い硬化でできた戦鎚です。戦鎚の形は、腕そのものが武器になっています。なっている武器が、エレンの攻撃を一度受け、割れ、また形を作ります。作る速度が、普通の巨人と違います。違う理由は、うなじを切っても本体がそこではない、です。ではない構造を、エレンは最初の一撃では知りません。知らない拳が、槌の柄に当たります。
segments.en: Before Eren's Titan looks for the next enemy, another body stands in the square. The body that stands is a war hammer made of white hardening. The shape of the hammer has made the arm itself into a weapon. The weapon it has become receives Eren's attack once, splits, and builds a shape again. The speed of building differs from an ordinary Titan. The reason it differs is that even if the nape is cut, the real body is not there. Eren does not know the structure that is not there in the first blow. The fist that does not know hits the handle of the hammer.

segments.ja: エレンは、戦鎚のうなじを割ります。割った中に、人がいません。いない事実が、戦いの規則を崩します。崩す相手は、硬化の糸のようなもので離れた場所から体を操っています。操っている場所を、彼はすぐに見つけられません。見つけられないあいだ、槌がもう一度組み立てられます。組み立てられる痛みを、彼は拳で返し続けます。返し続ける消耗が、島から来た体の限界です。限界の横で、マーレの戦士が動き始めます。
segments.en: Eren splits the nape of the war hammer. There is no person inside what he split. The fact of nobody being there breaks the rule of the fight. The opponent that breaks it is operating the body from a distant place, with something like a thread of hardening. He cannot find at once the place that is operating it. While he cannot find it, the hammer is assembled once more. He keeps returning, with his fist, the pain of being assembled. The exhaustion of keeping on returning is the limit of the body that came from the island. Beside the limit, Marley's warriors begin to move.

Magath sets in order, shortly, the posting that tries to shoot. The battlefield he sets in order was festival seats a few minutes ago. On the remains of the seats, three Titans surround one enemy. The enemy they surround has not yet found the real body of the hammer.

segments.ja: ライナーは、鎧になることを一度ためらいます。ためらう理由は、エレンの前でまた同じ失敗をする恐怖です。恐怖のあいだに、広場の被害は増えます。増える被害を見て、彼はそれでも変身します。変身した鎧は、四年で鈍った関節を鳴らしながらエレンへ向かいます。向かう背中は、候補たちが見た英雄の背中ではありません。ではありません。部屋で折れた男が、それでも町を盾にする背中です。盾の選択は、きれいではありません。
segments.en: Reiner hesitates once about becoming the Armor. The reason he hesitates is the fear of failing the same way again in front of Eren. While he fears, the damage in the square increases. Seeing the damage that increases, he transforms anyway. The Armor he transformed heads toward Eren while the joints dulled in four years sound. The back that heads there is not the hero's back the candidates saw. It is not. It is the back of the man who broke in the room, and who still makes the town a shield. The choice of the shield is not clean.

segments.en: Magath tries to pull the residents out of the circle of the Titans' fight. The road he tries to pull them along is thin with rubble. The order to push is a rescue and, at the same time, a posting that isolates the enemy. Inside the posting, the child candidates are not given priority. Gabi, not given it, chooses an alley herself.

segments.en: Under the broken seats, Falco searches for Gabi's voice. The ear that searches is filled with cannon and Titans' footsteps. Still in the larger guilt, he crawls out to the street. Ahead of where he came out, the white weapon of the war hammer is swung again. The wind of the swing pushes him back to the wall. The boy who is pushed back is no longer an errand boy for the mail.

segments.ja: エレンが槌の頭を砕いても、戦鎚は硬化を伸ばして次の武器を作ります。作るたびに、広場の建物がさらに落ちます。落ちる建材が、住民の逃げ道を塞ぎます。塞ぐ戦いを、エレンはうなじのない敵として苛立ちます。苛立つ拳が、地面を割って糸の方向を探します。探す方向の先に、まだ人の姿は見えません。見えない本体が、この巨人の本当のルールです。ルールを知ったあとも、切る場所はすぐには決まりません。
segments.en: Even when Eren smashes the head of the hammer, the war hammer stretches hardening and builds the next weapon. Each time it builds, more of the square's buildings fall. The building material that falls blocks the residents' escape. Eren is irritated by the fight that blocks, as an enemy with no nape. The irritated fist splits the ground and searches for the direction of the thread. Ahead of the direction he searches, a human figure is still not visible. The invisible real body is this Titan's true rule. Even after knowing the rule, the place to cut is not decided at once.

segments.en: Reiner's Armor puts its body between Eren and the war hammer. The reason it puts it there is to keep the town from being trampled completely. The choice of doing that is not only loyalty to Marley. It is not. His mother of the internment zone and the candidate children are still inside. He tries to protect the people who are there at the same time as the memory of the island. The Armor that tries to protect receives blows from both Titans. The joints that receive them turn four years of silence into sound. After the sound, he is still standing.

segments.en: Gabi picks up the gun of a fallen soldier. The reason she picks it up is that even if the opponent is a Titan, her points are still continuing. The idea that is continuing is still the success of the day of the train. In the idea left as it is, this square is too large. At the feet of the enemy that is too large, she calls Falco's name. The impatience he strengthened breaks more of the surrounding buildings. Pieck's cannon is also pulled into the range of the breaking. The Marley side that is pulled in has the advantage in numbers. Even with the advantage, if the place to cut is unknown, the upper hand is not complete. The night that is not complete changes Liberio's festival into the name of a battlefield. The world's guests remember the changed name while they run.
